author: opx
name: OPX MudBlazor Flat UI Web
description: Creates an OPX Flat UI Blazor Web app pinned to the verified 2.1.12 consumer contract with MudBlazor 9.9.0, including a theme-aware root startup gate before Router, configurable reconnect-style Memuat halaman spinner, Device/Manual font ownership, accessibility-scaled mobile button sizing, adaptive responsive rules, MAUI Android/iOS Community Toolkit, AppBar-synchronized status bar, bounce-free WebView and textbox-only selection guidance, clean initial run, package-owned reusable CSS, runtime OPX attribution, Settings, the default sidebar, and canonical widget spacing.
